tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by 14 different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
US civilian agencies can't use DeepSeek, the Department of Homeland Security says, reported by The Verge. An ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting a device had Saudi support, according to a court filing reported by BBC. Elon Musk and Anthropic pledge to give the public a piece of the artificial intelligence pie to address labor and economic impacts, confirmed by NBC News. Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation to scale artificial intelligence servers and challenge chipmakers, confirmed by the Independent Journal Review. Illinois Governor JB Pritzker thinks artificial intelligence could help us live to 100 or threaten us like nuclear weapons, confirmed by The Verge.
Free every hour.
